name: read-guard
description: Holds a whole-file Read (no offset/limit) of a file above the limit, a lockfile, minified code or a source map, and the same via cat, type or Get-Content in the shell; tells Claude the size, a token estimate and a better way (Grep, offset/limit). A second try at the same file goes through, and so does a Read with allow_large. Claude Code itself stops only at about 25,000 tokens.

limitKb.title: Read Guard: limit (KB)
limitKb.description: Files above this size are held when read whole. off: only lockfiles, minified files and source maps.

mode.title: Read Guard: mode
mode.description: block: hold the first try and tell Claude a better way. warn: only a notice.

shell.title: Read Guard: shell too
shell.description: on: also cat, type and Get-Content of a whole file.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the texts this mod shows and writes.
